_readme: Every video reads this file. Change a value, then refresh `npx remotion studio` (or re-render) to see it. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

video._tailSeconds: Silence kept after the last word so the video doesn't cut off abruptly.

colors._background: Two colors for the background gradient (top -> bottom).
colors._accents: Each scene takes the next accent in this list (scene 1 = first, and so on).

fonts._options: Montserrat, Inter, Poppins, Anton, Bebas Neue, Roboto. To add more, see src/fonts.ts.
fonts.heading: Montserrat

layout._padding: Space kept clear at the screen edges, in pixels.
layout._contentTop: Where the scene's visuals start (pixels from the top).

captions._position: Distance of the caption block from the bottom of the screen (pixels).
captions._wordsPerPage: Max words visible at once. A new 'page' also starts at each sentence end.
captions._highlight: 'box' = colored pill behind the active word, 'color' = active word changes color only.
captions._activeColor: Use 'accent' to follow the scene accent, or any CSS color.

motion._entrance: How elements appear on their cue word: 'pop', 'slide-up', 'fade' or 'zoom'.
motion._spring: Lower damping = more bounce. Higher stiffness = faster.
motion._leadFrames: Start the animation this many frames BEFORE the cue word, so it lands on the word.
motion._backgroundDrift: Slow movement of the background blobs. 0 = static.

voice._modelId: ElevenLabs model. eleven_multilingual_v2 supports the with-timestamps endpoint.

script._wordsPerSecond: Used to size the script and to fake timings in mock mode.
script._tone: Free text handed to the script writer.
script.tone: Curious, punchy and friendly. Short sentences. Open with a hook question. End with a memorable one-line takeaway.
